about-us.title: About us | Beachaven | Originally opened as Fondatore

paragraphs.text: Originally opened as Fondatore in 1964 and renamed to Beachaven in 1974. It has been under the same management since 1977.
paragraphs.html: Originally opened as Fondatore in 1964 and renamed to Beachaven in 1974. It has been under the same management since 1977.

paragraphs.text: In the 80s it was the in place for watersports and in the 90s it was renowned for the sunday afternoon parties.
paragraphs.html: In the 80s it was the in place for watersports and in the 90s it was renowned for the sunday afternoon parties.

paragraphs.text: It now features an Indian restaurant, night club, lido and berthing facilities.

You’ve been warned.

star-of-india.title: Star of India | Beachaven

paragraphs.text: The Star of India is an authentic Indian restaurant overlooking the panoramic views of Xemxija Bay, serving traditional Indian food from various regions of the Indian sub continent using only the finest and freshest ingredients. The chefs have many years of experience in top class restaurants abroad and therefor have the expertise to bring the true tastes of Indian cuisine to every dish. Each item on the menu can be prepared to suit any individual taste, so whether one’s preference is daringly spicy, or soothingly mild, the chefs will strive to prepare a tailor made dish to suit any liking with the full menu available for take away.
